description: L.A.B. New Ventures and Horizons is an engineering and educational simulation development team focused on space exploration mechanics. Our mission is to create interactive, scientifically grounded simulations for the NASA Space Apps Challenge, leveraging official open data from NASA (OSDR, RadLab, DONKI, Mars Trek) and partner agencies (CSA) to model autonomous outpost management, life support systems, and deep-space survival challenges on Mars.
